notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (429 rate_limit_error and the error shape) and platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits (retry-after in seconds; anthropic-ratelimit-{requests,input-tokens,output-tokens}-{limit,remaining,reset}, reset as RFC 3339); organization ID, limits and request_id invented. Not recordable: it needs an organization at its limit. A streaming request: StreamAnthropicMessage gets the 429 before any event.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X7: StreamAnthropicMessage turns every upstream error status into ErrUpstreamProvider (502, the raw body as its message), and the handler answers with that error, so a streaming /v1/messages client (Claude Code) gets a retryable 502 api_error instead of Anthropic's 429 rate_limit_error (or 400, 401, 404 ...) with its own body
known gap X3: the retry-after header (and every anthropic-ratelimit-* header) is dropped; models.APIError has no retry field
